title: proof-coverage-is-declared-and-a-proveme-ticket-without-it-reads-red
intention: A proof declares which ticket clauses each of its teeth covers, the seal records which teeth ran green, and a build_inspector sieve reds any ticket at PROVEME or beyond whose named proof does not cover every falsifier clause with a green tooth -- naming the missing clause.
why: Measured 2026-09-07: 19 tickets sit at PROVEME:waiting. 12 name a proof with a green seal, 7 name none. Three of the 12 (sleep-cycle token 4de7baf7e255, idle detection 9b6b392ebcfe, token rotation bf146e9e3967) name cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_trouble_panel.py, which contains zero mentions of idle, rotation, sleep or token; post-build reflection 68f563403c8f names test_codemother.py, which never mentions reflection. So a green seal on the named proof says nothing about whether the TICKET is proven -- four of the twelve are the hollow green Law 8 is written against, and nothing on disk can see it. The lived symptom: the operator sees 19 boats 'waiting' and cannot tell the proven from the parked without reading each proof, and the pile re-forms every week ('every time i let go of you, more debris accumulates').
how: (a) A tool cairn/tools/proof_coverage/ (users, not owners) reads two things: a proof's module-level `PROVES = {"<ticket-id>": {"<clause>": "<tooth name>", ...}}` and a ticket's falsifier as clause keys -- numbered '(N)' segments of the DONE-when string, or of falsifier.proves_red when the falsifier is a dict; a falsifier with no numbered clauses is one clause 'all'. A tooth name is the ok() label for ok-style proofs (18 in the corpus) or the test_ function name for pytest-style proofs (152). (b) The tester's run_proof parses the proof's FULL stdout for '  ok <name>' lines and pytest PASSED names and records them as evidence.teeth_green -- inside evidence, no ninth field; stdout_tail stays the 20-line tail it is. (c) Sieve proof_covers_the_ticket in build_inspector: for every ticket in CairnCommons/tickets/ at cursor PROVEME or later, resolve proven_by from the latest crossing; red with the lack named when: no proof named; proof file missing; proof declares nothing for this ticket; a clause is undeclared; a declared tooth is absent from the seal's teeth_green; the seal's source_fingerprint no longer matches. A concept-piece at PROVEME resolves its 'proof' to the review VALIDATION beside its artifact (validations_path_for_artifact, method 'review by N readers'); absent, it reds 'no review record'. (d) The 19: add PROVES to each named proof where a real tooth serves each clause; where none does (the four measured, the seven unnamed) the ticket takes a back-edge to BUILDME with the sieve's finding as the note, through clearance.clear -- never a hand edit of the cursor. Run the sieve before and after and record both counts in this ticket's crossing. Depends on nothing; a-green-seal-crosses-the-boat-it-proves depends on THIS (the door's gate is this predicate).
falsifier: DONE when: (1) a fixture proof carrying PROVES for one ticket, sealed green, has every declared tooth in evidence.teeth_green -- and a fixture printing 40 ok lines records all 40 (the 20-line stdout_tail does not bound it); (2) the sieve over a fixture ticket at PROVEME whose named proof declares clause (1) of a two-clause falsifier reds naming clause (2); (3) the sieve over a fixture whose proof declares every clause, every declared tooth green, fingerprint matching, produces no finding; (4) run over the live corpus before (d), it reds all 19 PROVEME tickets measured 2026-09-07 with the lack named per ticket, and the before/after counts are in this ticket's crossing; (5) a concept-piece at PROVEME with no review VALIDATION beside its artifact reds 'no review record'. WRONG INTENT if a PROVES block for one ticket routinely exceeds ~8 lines: the clauses are cut too fine and the falsifier, not the sieve, is what to fix.
traces_to: Law 8 -- nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass: today a ticket can name any green proof and nothing checks the binding. Law 9 -- red is the default, green is earned per clause, not per file. Law 3 -- the four hollow greens are a measurement, not a suspicion. Law 4 -- 'this ticket is proven' becomes a sieve, not a reading. Residue of 1b6516f92db3 green-is-earned-not-assumed (component_color derives color per component; this derives it per ticket).
